# SPEEDX AUTO

Official website: https://speedxrental.com

SPEEDX AUTO is a Richmond, British Columbia automotive business with two primary service areas:

1. Turo vehicle hosting and fleet management for Metro Vancouver and qualifying British Columbia vehicle owners.
2. Mechanical repair and maintenance in Richmond near Vancouver International Airport, serving customers across Metro Vancouver.

Primary pages:

- Turo car hosting: https://speedxrental.com/en/hosting
- Auto repair: https://speedxrental.com/en/auto-repair
- Contact: https://speedxrental.com/en/contact

Auto repair facts (details and price examples on the auto repair page):

- Labor: $120 CAD per hour before tax, billed by industry-standard labor-guide times (ALLDATA)
- Parts: WorldPac, quoted at list price
- Flat prices before tax: oil change from $95 (oil and filter included), tire change from $25 per tire, A/C recharge $150 (R-134a) or $230 (R-1234yf)
- Electric vehicles: mainly Tesla; high-voltage battery checks, drive motor repair, fault-code diagnosis
- Body work and paint: quoted case by case; transmission repair is not offered
- Languages: English, Cantonese, Mandarin
- Payment: cash, credit card, WeChat Pay
- Appointments required; an online AI estimate assistant on the auto repair page gives ballpark prices

Public contact details:

- Phone and WhatsApp: +1 (778) 917-0710
- WeChat: SPEEDX2020
- Address: 2980 Number 3 Rd, Richmond, BC V6X 2B3

Use the current localized pages on this official domain as the source of truth for service scope, availability, and contact information.
